name: Fortrydelsesknap.dk Withdrawal Button
author: Fortrydelsesknap.dk

sections.description:
From 19 June 2026 every website selling to EU consumers must offer a digital withdrawal button (“withdraw from contract here”). This is required by Directive (EU) 2023/2673 (new Art. 11a of the Consumer Rights Directive). A missing button can extend the consumer’s withdrawal right by 12 months.

Fortrydelsesknap.dk Withdrawal Button makes you compliant in 2 minutes:

  • The legally required button – correctly labelled, prominently displayed (floating, side tab or footer)
  • Two-step flow as required by the directive: form -> explicit confirmation step
  • Receipt on a durable medium: automatic e-mail confirmation to the consumer with receipt number
  • Instant notification to your shop e-mail
  • Complete log of all withdrawals in your dashboard (your documentation towards authorities)
  • 5 languages, each with the correct local legal term: Danish (fortrydelsesret / fortrydelsesknap), German (Widerrufsrecht / Widerrufsbutton), Swedish (ångerrätt / ångerknapp), Norwegian (angrerett / angreknapp) and English (right of withdrawal / withdrawal button)
  • Works with WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads, booking plugins, course platforms – anything sold to consumers

Available in your language

  • Dansk – Fortrydelsesknap og fortrydelsesformular til din webshop. Opfylder kravet om fortrydelse og 14 dages fortrydelsesret fra 19. juni 2026, så kunden nemt kan fortryde sit køb.
  • Deutsch – Widerrufsbutton und Widerrufsformular. Erfüllt das 14-tägige Widerrufsrecht ab 19. Juni 2026, damit Verbraucher ihren Kauf einfach widerrufen können.
  • Svenska – Ångerknapp och ångerformulär. Uppfyller konsumentens 14 dagars ångerrätt från 19 juni 2026, så att kunden enkelt kan ångra sitt köp.
  • Norsk – Angreknapp og angreskjema. Oppfyller forbrukerens 14 dagers angrerett fra 19. juni 2026, slik at kunden enkelt kan angre kjøpet.
  • English – Withdrawal button and form. Meets the 14 day right of withdrawal from 19 June 2026, so customers can easily cancel their purchase.

This plugin is developed and maintained by Fortrydelsesknap.dk. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the European Union.

Who needs this?

Webshops, coaches, course sellers, photographers, clinics with online booking, SaaS – everyone concluding contracts with EU consumers online, no matter where the business is located.

Why this plugin?

No setup wizard, no account, no external service. Install, choose language, done. Your data stays in YOUR WordPress database (GDPR-friendly, no processors involved).

Need the full return flow?

The button and everything in this plugin is free and stays free. If you also want returns, exchanges and complaints handled in one place — hosted return portal, WooCommerce/Shopify order lookup, photo documentation for complaints and a dashboard — have a look at Returportal Pro by the same team. Flat monthly price, no lock-in, no fee per return. The plugin itself never sends any data anywhere.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to “Fortrydelser” in the admin menu.
  3. Choose language, shop e-mail and button position. Done – compliant.
sections.faq:
Is this really mandatory?

Yes. Directive (EU) 2023/2673 applies from 19 June 2026 to all B2C distance contracts in the EU. Member states have implemented it into national law (e.g. § 356a BGB in Germany).

Does it apply to my small shop?

If consumers in the EU can buy goods, services or digital content on your site: yes.

B2B only?

Then you are exempt. Mixed B2B/B2C shops need the button.
sections.changelog:
1.3.1

  • New: landing on a URL with #fortryd (e.g. a link in your order confirmation e-mail: https://yourshop.com/#fortryd) now opens the withdrawal form directly. Menu items and links keep working as before.

1.3.0

  • New: “Settings” and “Returportal Pro” links on the plugins list, and an info box on the settings page about the optional hosted return portal (returns, exchanges, complaints) by the same team — shown in your chosen language
  • New: link to the free compliance check at fortrydelsesknap.dk/tjek, so you can verify your button is detected correctly
  • No functional changes to the button or the withdrawal flow. As always, the plugin sends no data anywhere — these are plain links.

1.2.3

  • Removed the “draggable button” option. It could leave the button stuck where a visitor had moved it – even after the option was switched off – because the position was remembered in the visitor’s browser. The button now always stays exactly where you place it, and any old remembered position is cleared automatically.

1.2.2

  • New: optional custom texts in the settings page. You can now override the button label, the form heading and the “you are withdrawing from …” line – for example use “purchase” instead of “contract”. Leave the fields blank to keep the legally safe default wording. Use the friendly [shop] tag where the shop name should appear.

1.2.1

  • Shop notification e-mail now shows the customer’s e-mail address, so you can see who withdrew at a glance
  • Reply-To on the shop notification is set to the customer, so you can reply directly from your inbox without opening the dashboard

1.2.0

  • Plugin renamed to “Fortrydelsesknap.dk Withdrawal Button” (new slug: fortrydelsesknap-dk)
  • All frontend CSS and JavaScript now loaded via wp_enqueue_style/wp_enqueue_script (separate assets/eufk.js)
  • All request input (POST/GET/SERVER) is now unslashed and sanitized before use, including the nonce check
  • Settings input validated against whitelists (language, position, hex color, offset range)

1.1.0

  • New positions: floating left/right, rotated side tab on the left/right screen edge, bottom of page, or hidden (shortcode/menu only)
  • Optional draggable button: visitors can move the button if it covers something; the position is remembered in their browser
  • Shortcode [fortrydelsesknap] places the button anywhere; menu items with URL #fortryd open the form
  • Adjustable edge offset so the button never collides with chat or cookie banners
  • Close (X) button, Escape key support, ARIA dialog attributes and visible keyboard focus states
  • Confirmation checkbox (“I confirm that I wish to exercise my right of withdrawal”) as an explicit second step
  • Shop name shown in the form (“You are withdrawing from a contract with …”)
  • Confirmation screen now states that a copy is sent by e-mail
  • Honeypot spam protection
  • CSV export of the withdrawal log (Excel-friendly)
  • Log now records user agent alongside IP and timestamp
  • Smaller button on mobile; safe-area insets respected

1.0.0

  • Initial release: two-step withdrawal flow, e-mail receipts, admin log, 5 languages.
